string-array.name: municipalities_array
string-array.item: Beijing is the capital of the Peoples Republic of China. It is a historic city combining ancient landmarks and modern development. It serves as the nation’s political and cultural center with a long history dating back hundreds of years.

Shanghai is China’s largest metropolitan city located on the coast. It is a major international economic and trade hub mixing old shikumen buildings with towering modern skyscrapers along the Huangpu river.

Chongqing is a large inland direct‑administered municipality in southwest China. Surrounded by mountains, it sits beside the Yangtze river and features unique mountain‑city landscape and fast‑growing industry.
Tianjin is a coastal municipality near Beijing. It blends traditional Chinese architecture and western‑style historical buildings, acting as an important northern port and industrial center of China.
